incident.title: Payment checkout outage — error rate spike
incident.description: Checkout error rate 12% since 14:02 UTC. Demo fixture for extraction + conflict + overdue + gap verification.

utterances.text: I am Priya, SRE Lead. Payments are failing hard — error rate spiked to 12% at checkout since 14:02 UTC.
Copy, I checked Datadog — DB replica lag on payments-db-03 is 45 seconds.
Confirmed — I see the same lag on my dashboard, and checkout 5xx count is 340 in last 5 minutes.
I think it's a recent deploy that caused this — maybe the retry logic merged at 13:40?
Support is getting flooded — 80 tickets in 10 minutes, all payment failures. Users retrying makes it worse.
Comms here — should we send a status page update? Customers are asking on Twitter.
Let's rollback the payment service to v2.14.3 — that rev reverts the retry change.
But wait — error rate just dropped to 2% on my screen at 14:06. Maybe the LB auto-scaled?
Conflicting — I still see 12% at 14:06. Alex, what time window are you looking at?
Can someone create a Jira to track the DB replica fix? Assign to Backend, due in 30 minutes.
Do it — but require approval before it posts to Jira. We'll confirm after rollback.
We need an owner for customer comms — I can't do it, I'm on tickets.

gaps.message: deploy retry logic caused outage (hypothesis not confirmed)

expectedExtractions.overdueActionTitle: Fix DB replica lag on payments-db-03
